content.short: Cero Network is a highly configurable decentralized consensus system.
content.description: Cero Network is a highly configurable decentralized consensus system that substantially strengthens the security, operational efficiency, and economic viability of both rollups and app-chains. By enabling shared sequencing, it creates and diversifies revenue streams, expands yield opportunities, and provides protection against MEV exploitation. Cero Network ensures robust censorship resistance, eliminates single points of failure, and delivers true decentralization for rollups.
content.meta: Cero Network is a configurable decentralized consensus system for rollups and app-chains. Discover Cero Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
